trs.20: About what are they asking one another?
trs.85: What are they asking about?
trs.22: Concerning what are they disputing?
trs.203: What are they asking (one another) about?

trs.20: About the great news<sup foot_note=197673>1</sup> -
trs.85: The momentous announcement
trs.22: Concerning the Great News,
trs.203: About the great news, (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism, the Qur’ân, which Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم brought and the Day of Resurrection)

trs.20: That over which they are in disagreement.
trs.85: about which they differ.
trs.22: About which they cannot agree.
trs.203: About which they are in disagreement.

trs.20: No! They are going to know.
trs.85: They will find out.
trs.22: Verily, they shall soon (come to) know!
trs.203: Nay, they will come to know!

trs.20: Then, no! They are going to know.
trs.85: In the end they will find out.
trs.22: Verily, verily they shall soon (come to) know!
trs.203: Nay, again, they will come to know!

trs.20: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
trs.85: Did We not make the earth smooth,
trs.22: Have We not made the earth as a wide expanse,
trs.203: Have We not made the earth as a bed,

trs.20: And the mountains as stakes?<sup foot_note=197674>1</sup>
trs.85: and make the mountains to keep it stable?
trs.22: And the mountains as pegs?
trs.203: And the mountains as pegs?

trs.20: And We created you in pairs.
trs.85: Did We not create you in pairs,
trs.22: And (have We not) created you in pairs,
trs.203: And We have created you in pairs (male and female, tall and short, good and bad, etc.).

trs.20: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
trs.85: give you sleep for rest,
trs.22: And made your sleep for rest,
trs.203: And We have made your sleep as a thing for rest.

trs.20: And made the night as clothing<sup foot_note=197675>1</sup>.
trs.85: the night as a cover,
trs.22: And made the night as a covering,
trs.203: And We have made the night as a covering (through its darkness),

trs.20: And made the day for livelihood.
trs.85: and the day for your livelihood?
trs.22: And made the day as a means of subsistence?
trs.203: And We have made the day for livelihood.

trs.20: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens].
trs.85: Did We not build seven strong [heavens] above you,
trs.22: And (have We not) built over you the seven firmaments,
trs.203: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),

trs.20: And made [therein] a burning lamp
trs.85: and make a blazing lamp?
trs.22: And placed (therein) a Light of Splendour?
trs.203: And We have made (therein) a shining lamp (sun).

trs.20: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water.
trs.85: Did We not send water pouring down from the clouds
trs.22: And do We not send down from the clouds water in abundance,
trs.203: And We have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water.

trs.20: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation.
trs.85: to bring forth with it grain, plants,
trs.22: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetables,
trs.203: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetations,

trs.20: And gardens of entwined growth.
trs.85: and luxuriant gardens?
trs.22: And gardens of luxurious growth?
trs.203: And gardens of thick growth.

trs.20: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
trs.85: A time has been appointed for the Day of Decision:
trs.22: Verily the Day of Sorting out is a thing appointed,
trs.203: Verily, the Day of Decision is a fixed time,

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا

trs.20: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
trs.85: a Day when the Trumpet will sound and you will come forward in crowds,
trs.22: The Day that the Trumpet shall be sounded, and ye shall come forth in crowds;
trs.203: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and you shall come forth in crowds (groups after groups). [Tafsir At-Tabari]

trs.20: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways.
trs.85: when the sky will open up like wide portals,
trs.22: And the heavens shall be opened as if there were doors,
trs.203: And the heaven shall be opened, and it will become as gates,

trs.20: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
trs.85: when the mountains will vanish like a mirage.
trs.22: And the mountains shall vanish, as if they were a mirage.
trs.203: And the mountains shall be moved away from their places and they will be as if they were a mirage.

trs.20: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
trs.85: Hell lies in wait,
trs.22: Truly Hell is as a place of ambush,
trs.203: Truly, Hell is a place of ambush -

trs.20: For the transgressors, a place of return,
trs.85: a home for oppressors
trs.22: For the transgressors a place of destination:
trs.203: A dwelling place for the Tâghûn (those who transgress the boundary limits set by Allâh like polytheists, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh, hyprocrites, sinners, criminals),

trs.20: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
trs.85: to stay in for a long, long time,
trs.22: They will dwell therein for ages.
trs.203: They will abide therein for ages.

verses.text_uthmani: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا

trs.20: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.
trs.85: where they will taste no coolness nor drink
trs.22: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink,
trs.203: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink.

trs.20: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
trs.85: except one that is scalding and dark––
trs.22: Save a boiling fluid and a fluid, dark, murky, intensely cold,
trs.203: Except boiling water, and dirty wound discharges -

trs.20: An appropriate recompense.<sup foot_note=197676>1</sup>
trs.85: a fitting requital,
trs.22: A fitting recompense (for them).
trs.203: An exact recompense (according to their evil crimes).

trs.20: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
trs.85: for they did not fear a reckoning,
trs.22: For that they used not to fear any account (for their deeds),
trs.203: For verily, they used not to look for a reckoning.

trs.20: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
trs.85: and they rejected Our messages as lies.
trs.22: But they (impudently) treated Our Signs as false.
trs.203: But they belied Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, and that which Our Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم brought) completely.

trs.20: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
trs.85: We have recorded everything in a Record.
trs.22: And all things have We preserved on record.
trs.203: And all things We have recorded in a Book.

trs.20: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."<sup foot_note=197677>1</sup>
trs.85: ‘Taste this: all you will get from Us is more torment.’
trs.22: "So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds); for no increase shall We grant you, except in Punishment."
trs.203: So taste you (the results of your evil actions). No increase shall We give you, except in torment.

trs.20: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment<sup foot_note=197678>1</sup> -
trs.85: For those who were aware of God there is supreme fulfilment:
trs.22: Verily for the Righteous there will be a fulfilment of (the heart's) desires;
trs.203: Verily, for the Muttaqûn,<sup foot_note=155028>1</sup> there will be a success (Paradise);

trs.20: Gardens and grapevines.
trs.85: private gardens, vineyards,
trs.22: Gardens enclosed, and grapevines;
trs.203: Gardens and vineyards,

trs.20: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age.
trs.85: nubile, well-matched companions,
trs.22: And voluptuous women of equal age;
trs.203: And young full-breasted (mature) maidens of equal age,

trs.20: And a full cup.<sup foot_note=197679>1</sup>
trs.85: and an overflowing cup.
trs.22: And a cup full (to the brim).
trs.203: And a full cup (of wine).

verses.text_uthmani: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا

trs.20: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
trs.85: There they will hear no vain or lying talk:
trs.22: No vanity shall they hear therein, nor Untruth:-
trs.203: No Laghw (dirty, false, evil talk) shall they hear therein, nor lying;

trs.20: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,<sup foot_note=197680>1</sup>
trs.85: a reward from your Lord, a fitting gift
trs.22: Recompense from thy Lord, a gift, (amply) sufficient,
trs.203: A reward from your Lord, an ample calculated gift (according to the best of their good deeds),<sup foot_note=155029>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا

trs.20: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.<sup foot_note=197681>1</sup>
trs.85: from the Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between, the Lord of Mercy. They will have no authority from Him to speak.
trs.22: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between, (Allah) Most Gracious: None shall have power to argue with Him.
trs.203: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and whatsoever is in between them, the Most Gracious, with Whom they cannot dare to speak (on the Day of Resurrection except by His Leave).

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا

trs.20: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
trs.85: On the Day when the Spirit and the angels stand in rows, they will not speak except for those to whom the Lord of Mercy gives permission, who will say only what is right.
trs.22: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand forth in ranks, none shall speak except any who is permitted by (Allah) Most Gracious, and He will say what is right.
trs.203: The Day that Ar-Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel) or another angel] and the angels will stand forth in rows, they will not speak except him whom the Most Gracious (Allâh) allows, and he will speak what is right.

verses.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا

trs.20: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.<sup foot_note=197682>1</sup>
trs.85: That is the Day of Truth. So whoever wishes to do so should take the path that leads to his Lord.
trs.22: That Day will be the sure Reality: Therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) return to his Lord!
trs.203: That is (without doubt) the True Day. So, whosoever wills, let him seek a place with (or a way to) His Lord (by obeying Him in this worldly life)!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا

trs.20: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth<sup foot_note=197683>1</sup> and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
trs.85: We have warned you of imminent torment, on the Day when every person will see what their own hands have sent ahead for them, when the disbeliever will say, ‘If only I were dust!’
trs.22: Verily, We have warned you of a Penalty near, the Day when man will see (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the Unbeliever will say, "Woe unto me! Would that I were (mere) dust!"
trs.203: Verily, We have warned you of a near torment - the Day when man will see that (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say: "Woe to me! Would that I were dust!"
